guides.title: 光子相位陣列：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical phased arrays: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: OPA 光束方向由相位斜率與取樣間距決定。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: OPA steering depends on phase slope and element spacing. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：OPA 光束方向由相位斜率與取樣間距決定。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測主瓣角度、旁瓣及柵瓣。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.
Mark this question on your own diagram: OPA steering depends on phase slope and element spacing. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure main-lobe angle, sidelobes and grating lobes. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測主瓣角度、旁瓣及柵瓣」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure main-lobe angle, sidelobes and grating lobes, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子相位陣列：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Optical phased arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「陣列因子：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Array factor: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜陣列因子：模型與設計：比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。
觀察站 2｜熱相位校正：模型與設計：量相位-功率矩陣並以全陣列同時驅動回驗。
觀察站 3｜掃描包絡驗收：量測與判別：在邊角與溫度角落量主瓣、旁瓣及有效發射功率。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Array factor: model and design: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.
Observation station 2 | Thermal phase calibration: model and design: Measure the phase-power matrix and retest with all elements driven.
Observation station 3 | Scan-envelope acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Measure main lobe, sidelobes and useful emitted power at scan and temperature corners.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「熱相位校正：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「掃描包絡驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Thermal phase calibration: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scan-envelope acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

courses.summary: 光子相位陣列以陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Optical phased arrays links device physics and system validation through array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 低串擾天線陣列研究
history.text: Nature Communications / research authors 的「低串擾與寬視野積體光學相位陣列」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: Nature Communications / research authors: Reduced-crosstalk wide-field integrated optical phased arrays provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
